title: Sloppy Quorums Configured by Default for Strong Consistency
pattern: Relying on sloppy quorums with hinted handoffs for read and write operations that require causal or linearizable consistency.
why_bad: Sloppy quorums only guarantee durability (the data is written *somewhere*), not consistency. If target replica nodes are partitioned, writes are accepted on temporary nodes. Reading a quorum from target replicas during partition will return stale data until hinted handoff can complete [332, 333].
detection: Identify data read or write queries targeting leaderless replicated clusters configured with sloppy quorums and hinted handoff when linearizable or strong causal consistency is assumed.
fix: Disable sloppy quorums (use strict quorums where $R + W > N$) for operations where stale reads are unacceptable.
source: Martin Kleppmann, *Designing Data-Intensive Applications*, page 177 / passage [332, 333].
